title: Treatment from Self-inflicted Injuries not Covered under MediShield Life
what_it_is: Treatment from Self-inflicted Injuries not Covered under MediShield Life

sections.label: MediShield Life self-inflicted injury claims
sections.summary: About 300 self-inflicted injury claims were excluded yearly from 2016 to 2018, but exceptions may be considered for injuries from an existing mental condition.

sentences.speaker: Ms Anthea Ong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In a Parliamentary Question (PQ) that I had filed last month, it was shared that from 2016 to 2018, we had about 300 claims in this category that were excluded every year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: As I had mentioned, we exclude them as a general rule because you do not encourage this kind of behaviour.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: We do not want to encourage people to self-inflict injuries and that is why MediShield Life does not cover it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Nonetheless, to the extent that these injuries arise as a result of an existing mental condition that might pre-dispose the claimant or the person to inflicting the injuries on himself or herself, in those situations, we can consider exceptions to the general positions.
